# Phillips 66 Named Official Fuel Partner of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA

Partnership will support fueling operations for thousands of vehicles and equipment and provide fuel for the Olympic and Paralympic Torch Relays. [...] HOUSTON AND LOS ANGELES (Nov. 12, 2026) – Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX) today announced it will serve as the Official Fuel Partner of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. The partnership brings the company’s fuel supply and distribution capabilities to the LA28 Games and Team USA as Los Angeles prepares to welcome athletes and fans from around the world. [...] “Every Team USA athlete has a unique journey, shaped by years of dedication, sacrifice and the pursuit of a dream,” said Sarah Hirshland, CEO, U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Committee. “It takes a strong community of partners to help bring those dreams to life, and we’re grateful to have Phillips 66 alongside us as we prepare for the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Their support will help deliver an incredible experience for athletes and fans alike while supporting the journeys of the athletes
